nodes.summary: For every natural number $m$, $\sum_{k=0}^{m} \binom{2m}{2k} E_{2k}$ is $1$ if $m = 0$ and $0$ if $m \ge 1$.
nodes.title: Binomial recurrence for the even-index Euler numbers
Recursion for the even-index Euler numbers

nodes.summary: The integers $E_0, E_2, E_4, \dots$ defined recursively by $E_0 = 1$ and $E_{2m} = -\sum_{k=0}^{m-1} \binom{2m}{2k} E_{2k}$ for $m \ge 1$; equivalently, $\sum_{k=0}^{m} \binom{2m}{2k} E_{2k}$ is $1$ for $m = 0$ and $0$ for $m \ge 1$. The value at $n$ is $E_{2n}$.
nodes.title: Even-index Euler numbers

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n$, $2^{2n} (2^{2n} - 1) B_{2n} = 2n \sum_{k=0}^{n-1} \binom{2n-2}{2k} E_{2k} E_{2n-2k-2}$, where $B_m$ are the Bernoulli numbers and $E_{2k}$ are the even-index Euler numbers.
nodes.title: Bernoulli numbers as a convolution of even-index Euler numbers

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.
